Subject: Update on your application for the Marketing position

Dear [Candidate Name],

Thank you for giving us the opportunity to review your application for the Marketing position. We appreciate the time and effort you put into your submission.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience more closely aligns with our current needs. Please know that this decision was not a reflection of your skills or potential, as we were impressed by your background. However, we are looking for a slightly different fit for this specific role.

We will keep your resume on file and encourage you to apply for future openings that may be a better match for your talents.

We wish you the very best in your job search and future professional endeavors.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Company Name]
